quizzes.question_text: What is the square root of 225?\n\n
solution: The square root of a number is the value that, when multiplied by itself, gives that number. $\\[1em]$ So we are looking for a number $z$ such that $z \times z = 225$, written $z^2 = 225$.
To find $\sqrt{225}$, think of perfect squares we already know and work toward $225$. $\\[1em]$ Testing: $15^2 = 15 \times 15 = 225$. $\\[1em]$ So $15$ is the number that squares to $225$.
